title: Zoe slider
description: A swipeable card row that snaps card by card and runs off the right edge, with a full-width hairline progress bar whose dark fill grows card by card (0.3s) and two round chevron buttons underneath, flush left.
notes: native scroll-snap, no carousel library; the progress bar and arrows need JavaScript (hydrate visible)
tone="band" makes the bar and buttons translucent white, for coloured bands
hide the controls at a breakpoint with controlsClassName (e.g. lg:hidden when every card fits)
name: zoe-slider

props.name: slideClassName
props.description: classes for each slide wrapper: its width (e.g. "w-[37.5rem]")

props.name: prevLabel
props.description: screen-reader names of the two buttons

props.name: tone
props.description: light: dark bar and white buttons, for white pages · band: translucent white, for coloured bands

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: extra classes for the scrolling row (side padding, gap, centring at a breakpoint)

props.name: controlsClassName
props.description: extra classes for the progress bar + buttons (e.g. "lg:hidden")
